# Capture fixtures

All transcript text, identifiers, paths, tool results and encrypted-looking values
are synthetic. No personal transcript has been copied into this project.

Claude 2.1.263 fixture shapes cover message content blocks, `system/away_summary`
with `content`, and `ai-title`. Codex 0.153.4 shapes cover session metadata,
response items, turn lifecycle and inaccessible compaction content. These use the
September 9 audit documented in the implementation plan; additional lifecycle
shapes are synthetic adapter cases, not an end-to-end provider capability claim.
The desktop originator is source metadata and does not prove a live surface link.

Tests construct partial writes, malformed lines, byte-preserving rotation,
ambiguous rewrites, revisions and duplicate delivery from these fixtures in memory.
`identity-v1.json` freezes independent Python-generated canonical bytes and hashes.
